facts.fact: Le Sahel reports that the national digital and financial literacy campaign for rural populations, part of the World Bank-funded PVI project under the national information society agency ANSI, trained nearly 38,000 people nationwide in phase one against a 65,000 target, with phase two launched at a trainers' workshop in Niamey on 20-24 June 2024.
